workflow.name: Greenfield Architecture
workflow.trigger: new project, start from scratch, empty project, initial design, system design, architect new
workflow.description: High-level architecture for new systems or major initiatives.

step.goal: Define system boundaries, components, and their responsibilities. Establish technology choices with trade-off analysis. Design data model, API contracts, and integration points. Document deployment topology and scaling strategy.
Critique architecture for gaps, risks, and over-engineering. Validate alignment with stated requirements. Challenge assumptions and identify hidden complexity.
Incorporate valid critique. Finalize architecture document.
